Yard throughput, and why the depot average hides it

A depot that averages ninety minutes a handover is not a depot where handovers take ninety minutes. It is usually a depot where most take forty and a handful take six hours, and the six-hour ones are the entire problem. The average is the one number that cannot show you that.

What the model actually reads

Three fields, all of which already exist on the handheld: the seal scan, the weighbridge slip, and the supervisor sign-off. Nothing new is collected. The model only cares about the gaps between them, because a gap is where a trailer sits still while somebody looks for a piece of paper.
